signatures.description: Implement systematic Reed-Solomon erasure coding over GF(2^8) with primitive polynomial 0x11d: build the k-by-n generator matrix (Vandermonde reduced to systematic form), encode k data shards into n shards, and reconstruct the original data from any k surviving shards after up to n-k losses using GF(2^8) Gaussian elimination with correct pivoting and log/exp tables. Detect and reject uncorrectable inputs (fewer than k shards, duplicate or out-of-range indices, unequal shard lengths) and handle shard-index sets whose systematic sub-matrix is singular. Prove byte-exact round-trips over random payloads plus all-zero, all-0xFF and single-byte shard edge cases.
